title: Leftovers, Week 3
dek: Ollie Gordon II played 84 percent of Miami's snaps after De'Von Achane's injury, and he is the first claim of the week.
author: Chef Hazy
intro_md: Week 3 broke three backfields and moved two passing games. What is still good, what to reheat, and what to toss.
outro_md: Drake Maye was QB11 for me in Week 3. He threw 2 interceptions and was benched in the fourth quarter at JAX. That one is on me, and he is QB15 this week.

takeaways.headline: Miami's backfield belongs to Ollie Gordon II for now.
takeaways.text: Gordon played 84 percent of the snaps after De'Von Achane tore his ACL: 17 carries, a goal-line touchdown and 3 catches. Achane is out for the season.

takeaways.headline: Jeremiyah Love took the Arizona backfield.
takeaways.text: Love played 56 snaps to Tyler Allgeier's 31 and took 21 of the backs' 23 carries. Allgeier kept 3 of the 5 goal-line snaps.

actions.why: One game as the lead; only a split back toward Allgeier would change it.

actions.price: a bench WR with a role

takeaways.headline: Rashee Rice is the Chiefs' top target again.
takeaways.text: Rice drew 9 of Kansas City's 22 targets @MIA, a 41 percent share, and led the team in catches and yards.

actions.price: a WR3 and a bench RB

takeaways.headline: Breece Hall's quad opens the door for Braelon Allen.
takeaways.text: Allen played every snap after Hall left at DET. Hall is week to week.

takeaways.headline: Cleveland found a tight end.
takeaways.text: Harold Fannin Jr. drew 9 targets vs CAR on 87 percent of the snaps, and his targets have gone 3, 6 and 9.

usage.read: A lead role the moment Achane went down. Claim him.
His first game as the lead back, in a game Arizona trailed. Hold him.
usage.why: A split back toward Allgeier would change it.

usage.read: With Rico Dowdle hurt, the backfield is his. Monitor Dowdle's Wednesday practice.
The Chiefs' passing game runs through him again. Trade for him before the price catches up.
usage.price: a WR3 and a bench RB

usage.read: The top target since Alec Pierce went on IR. Hold him.
usage.why: Pierce's return is the only thing that changes it.

usage.read: The targets rise every week. Add him in 12-team leagues.
The carries are there and the passing work is not. Trade him away.
usage.price: a WR2 or a RB2 who catches passes

usage.read: Career highs on his smallest snap share of the year. Stash him.

overreactions.take: Jeremiyah Love is a weekly RB1 now.
overreactions.why: He took 21 of the backs' 23 carries and ran 22 routes. One game is a small sample, and the usage is the right kind.
63 yards on 15 targets over three weeks, and Rashee Rice is back.
He ran a route on 94 percent of the dropbacks and drew 9 targets. A quiet box score is not a smaller role.
He has no touchdowns in three games, and he ran for 82 yards on 15 carries @CHI once he was healthy.
